article.title: Indian Markets End Week Under Pressure: Nifty at 22,600, Sensex at 73,123.83
article.dek: On Friday 23 October 2026, Nifty 50 ended at 22,600.00 and Sensex at 73,123.83 as the market sell-off continued.
body: Indian stocks ended Friday 23 October under pressure. The Nifty 50 closed at 22,600.00, down 87.65 points in the session. The Sensex closed at 73,123.83, down 125.56 points.
The reported declines describe Friday’s session rather than the full five-session return.
The full weekly large-cap gainers and losers ranking is omitted because the available source dataset does not establish a verified five-session return for every constituent.
article.indiaImpact: The headline benchmarks ended lower on Friday; daily declines should not be confused with full-week performance.
